ocl:
context Customer
inv: ((self.cart <> null) and (self.cart.oclIsTypeOf(Cart))) and (self.fullName.toLowerCase() = 'test')

context ReturnRequest
inv: (self.item.order = self.order) and (self.reason <> null)

context Customer
inv: (self.addresses->collect(x | x.postalCode)->notEmpty()) and (self.email <> '' and self.email.size() > 0)

context Cart
inv: (self.items->any(x | x.quantity >= 10) <> null) and (self.createdAt.size() = 44)

context InventoryItem
inv: self.quantity >= 49 and self.quantity <= 94

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 59 and self.amount <= 76

context CartItem
inv: self.quantity >= 11 and self.quantity <= 88

context Product
inv: (self.reviews->collect(x | x.rating)->sum() >= 8) and (self.basePrice <> null)

context Cart
inv: (self.createdAt <> null) and (self.items->any(x | x.quantity > 5) <> null)

context ReturnRequest
inv: (self.order.customer.fullName <> '') and (self.requestedAt.size() >= 4 implies self.requestedAt.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Product
inv: (self.reviews->notEmpty()) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)

context Product
inv: ((self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 5) and (self.variants->any(x | x.priceDelta > 0) <> null)) and (not((self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 5) and (self.variants->any(x | x.priceDelta > 0) <> null)))

context Cart
inv: ((self.createdAt <> '') and (self.items->forAll(v | v.quantity > 2))) and (self.items->exists(v | not(v.quantity > 2)))

context Store
inv: (self.categories->exists(x | x.title <> '')) and (not(self.categories->exists(x | x.title <> '')))

context Product
inv: (self.category.store = self.store) and (not(self.category.store = self.store))

context Order
inv: (self.items->size() >= 3 and self.items->size() <= 3) and (self.items->size() < 3)

context Coupon
inv: ((self.orders->any(x | x.placedAt <> '') <> null) and (self.code.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.orders->any(x | x.placedAt <> '') <> null) and (self.code.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Product
inv: ((self.sku <> null) and (self.basePrice.abs() <= 1)) and (not((self.sku <> null) and (self.basePrice.abs() <= 1)))

context Customer
inv: ((self.customerId <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.line1 <> ''))) and (not((self.customerId <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.line1 <> ''))))

context Product
inv: ((self.basePrice < 100) and (self.variants->forAll(v | v.priceDelta <= 100))) and (self.basePrice > 105)

context Customer
inv: ((self.email <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.city <> ''))) and (self.addresses->exists(v | not(v.city <> '')))

context Order
inv: (self.items->exists(x | x.unitPrice > 1)) and (not(self.items->exists(x | x.unitPrice > 1)))
